verdict: MONOTONICITY — OK. u1d decreases from the inlet to the outlets on every edge (worst rise +0.000e+00, within noise). Pressure falls along the tree, as it must with one source.

MASS CONSERVATION — OK. Delivery 1.623338e-03 vs absorption 1.623338e-03, relative imbalance 6.74e-08. These are computed by completely different routes (the discrete coupling operators C and G vs a volume integral), so agreement to this level is strong evidence the coupling is correct.
COUPLING OPERATOR — OK. max|C@1 - 1| = 4.44e-16. The circle-average reproduces constants exactly, so it is mass-preserving by construction.

RESOLUTION — the 3D cells are up to 16x larger than the thinnest vessel (h=0.0866). The line source is smeared over a cell, so the perivascular gradient is unresolved and u3d overshoots max(u1d) by +6.92e-03. This is a genuine modelling limitation, not a bug: resolving it needs local refinement around the centerlines.
